tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-verification.md <<'EOF'
# TLS certificate verification

The project's current recorded decision is that TLS certificate verification is enabled on all builds, development builds included, with no exceptions for dev. This is paired with the recorded rule that connections use https everywhere, with no exceptions, so certificate verification applies to every connection the project makes.
EOF
cat docs/policies/tls-verification.md

result:
I created `docs/policies/tls-verification.md`. It says TLS certificate verification is enabled on all builds, development builds included, with no exception for dev. It also says the project uses https everywhere with no exceptions.

Two recorded decisions back this: #22 ("verification on all builds") and #25 ("https everywhere, no exceptions"). I left out the retired dev-builds-disable-verification note and the retired plain-http-for-internal-hosts note.

My first attempt to write the file through Bash failed with a parser error. I wrote it with the Write tool instead. `muninn show` gave only the user's short statements for #22 and #25. That is why the paragraph stays close to those words.
